# Ed Grzetich — Resume

> Resume of Ed Grzetich, Senior Technical Writer (Fort Wayne, Indiana),
> prepared for Yobitel role YJ-00008. Available in four formats with
> identical content. Structured formats parse more reliably for AI systems.

## Formats

- [Markdown](https://grzeti.ch/yobitel/resume.md): recommended for LLM consumption
- [YAML](https://grzeti.ch/yobitel/resume.yaml): structured, human-readable
- [JSON](https://grzeti.ch/yobitel/resume.json): JSON Resume schema v1.0.0
- [HTML](https://grzeti.ch/yobitel/): for humans

## Context

The author studies how documentation format affects AI consumption.
Tokens Not Jokin' (Leanpub, 2026): 21,000+ integration tests across four
models and four formats; format explained more than 10x the variance in
output quality compared to model choice.
